new_source.name: Paimon.moe Genshin wish banner historical archive

limitations: Weapon banner item counts are weapon rate-up slots, not unique weapons, and must not be added to per-character sales.
The new 735 items are community-sourced. No assertion is made that the publisher's individual notices for all 105 banners were verified.
The original dataset is unchanged and the web client merges the supplemental archive. If the archive cannot be loaded, the original data still loads.
All-time completion for all six games, including all weapons, official provenance and every character banner, remains unverified.
